notes.title: Interactive Circle of 5ths, Falling Notes checkpoints, SoundFont Creator & more!
notes.content:
[p]Lots of updates - as usual PianoGlow is heavily based on user feedback:[/p][list][*][p][b]Falling Notes Mode - adjustable time: [/b]You can adjust the time in the Falling Notes game mode and also load/save checkpoints to practice specific sections more. Thanks @jax05282 for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Circle Of Fifths - Interactive: [/b]You can hover on the Circle of Fifths to preview the triad chord (left/right click to play the triad or 7th respectively). It can be hidden under Settings > Show/Hide. This is fundamental and helpful for new beginners, which is why it's enabled by default so they know it exists (but it can be disabled).[/p][/*][*][p][b]SoundFont Presets[/b] - As a minority of SoundFont files contain more than one preset (sometimes referred to as instruments), you can now access these individual presets. Thanks @7vlw for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customize Glow/Particles: [/b]You can now customize the glow of the note beams which will improve visibility (thanks @Wh0ze for suggesting this idea) and remove the particle effects (thank you @Shoeb for the idea).[/p][/*][*][p][b]SoundFont Creator: [/b]A very simple SoundFont creator has been added if you want to make your own SoundFonts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tip Sent/Received Achievements: [/b]+19 tip achievements added and fixed, given when you send/receive coins in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wooting Improvements: [/b]The algorithms on the Wooting analog keyboards on inferring velocity has been improved but will improve again later after further testing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Several new SoundFonts (in the Funny category):[/b] Thanks to KreativeKorp for providing permission in adding several of these SoundFont files in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed showing misleading triads & improved chord identifier:[/b] in the treble/bass staff, fixed misleading notes that showed when in conjuction with the chord identifier (e.g. now shows Eb G Bb instead of D# G A#) for the Eb triad. Thanks @Nyx for the consultation and his music knowledge![/p][/*][*][p][b]Record With Transpose:[/b] Option when recording MIDI to record the note transposed or the note pressed. Thanks @noakopiano for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ultra-wide HD monitor support: [/b]UI better fits e.g. 3440x1440. Thanks @HeRmEtIkA for reporting this issue.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor updates/fixes:[/b] Rendering settings shown before saving video + render FPS setting. Access Falling Notes Game Mode in the "Play" in addition to the "Game Modes" menu. Discord Presence temporarily disabled to see if it was a major cause of crashes. Daily Reward now is awarded even if you don't start the chat (as long as the game successfully connects - thanks @Ayien for the bug report).[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for the support and I hope to code more updates on the 1st of next month,
- TheAlanski@[/p]

notes.title: Leaderboards, Ear Chord Training, More Stats, Input/Output, Roadmap/Vision
notes.content:
[h1]Big batch of updates[/h1][p]Lots of updates - as usual PianoGlow is heavily based on user feedback:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ear Chord Training:[/b] - identify the type of chord e.g. Major 7th, Augmented 7th 2nd Inversion, etc. Thanks Nyx@ for the idea & insights about this![/p][/*][*][p][b]MIDI Input devices:[/b] now selectable for customization. Thanks aussie2@ for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]MIDI Output devices[/b]. Thanks noakopiano@ for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More stats: [/b]Times Changed Soundfont, Audio Saved, Midi Loaded etc. Also thanks @7vlw for the idea of Total Playtime Hours and Coin Earning related stats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards:[/b] for some of these new stats including Total Steam Playtime (thanks @7vlw and Sxronxploits@ for the ideas related to leaderboards). A tip tax (10%) is added so that tipping stats/leaderboards are more meaningful. Some stats and leaderboards are new and will be refreshed once you open the app.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clickable player profiles:[/b] - view their Soundfont & Reverb settings & some stats in multiplayer! You can also click on the chat names for this.[/p][/*][*][p][b]61 and 49 piano keys:[/b] under [i]Settings > Piano[/i]. Defaults to 88. Thanks Wh0ze@ for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PDF Navigation Improved: [/b]PGUP/PGDN shortcut, "Fit To Page Height" button near the zoom. This is shared with the notepad's page shortcuts (P.S. it was changed from INS/DEL and swapped with the volume shortcuts). Thanks Nyx@ for the idea.[/p][/*][*][p][b]+38 more achievements (now totalling 70):[/b] Times Opened Settings, Sheet Music Training Achievements, Funny Ones like "Commitment Issues" achievement if you changed your SoundFont too often, Loading Or Saving Audio, and more![/p][/*][*][p][b]In-game ban system:[/b] includes chat bans + ban-timers/audit-log. Fortunately as of now, in-game users were well-behaved such that it wasn't ever needed since multiplayer was released[i] *knocks on wood*[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes: [/b]including some types of crashes, alt velocity fix. Thanks noakopiano@ & 7vlw@ for the detailed reports. I will monitor the logs further for crashes - these will be the highest priority bugs to fix![/p][/*][*][p][b]Miscellaneous updates: [/b]Improved Help/About Page, Store Page Small Adjustments (highlighted a user's review on the store homepage), Room Name in the browse lobby list takes on the special effects/gradient of the host.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Continuous development in Early Access: [/b]price increased. Wishlist to be notified of the regular discounts and email [i]hi@alan.co.uk[/i] if you have any enquiries![/p][/*][*][p][b]Mac OSX Removal: [/b]Mac OSX users will later be automatically refunded because Mac OSX support will be later removed. This is because Mac OSX users account for ~2% of PianoGlow users and more focus can be provided for the ~98% of Windows users. Additionally developing on Mac OSX is harder. For complaints regarding this, email [i]hi@alan.co.uk[/i].
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Roadmap? Vision? What's Next?
[/h1][p][b]Vision: [/b]PianoGlow's goal is to be a fun [b][i]all-in-one piano[/i][/b] app, i.e. online multiplayer game (jam with others, take turns playing or teach someone remotely, stats & leaderboards, community), MIDI & QWERTY game modes (can be used to supplement learning/training but not replace it) and high-quality unique visualizations (render options for social media or livestreaming).[/p][p][/p][p]Can't promise as things usually pivot, but a brief overview of what might be next:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Discord's #idea-forums (First Priority): [/b]this is[i] [u]the[/u][/i] detailed roadmap (I'm not keen on a duplicate/explicit roadmaps as things pivot and I like keeping the process lightweight/improvized and heavily influenced by continuous user feedback, the threads here are organized here with tags of which ones are complete and can sort by recent activity). Many are prioritized based on how beneficial it is to the users relative to how difficult/fun I find coding it and for now, niche features affecting a small number of users are usually (not always) less priority e.g. ear training was used only by < 5 % of users but can still be important if those 4-5% use the app primarily for ear training (tracked via Achievement stats). This is a good forum as real direct user needs/complaints on the Discord forums are extremely important to address - feel free to comment/bump your favorite ideas and debate there. Every idea is guaranteed to be read, but some might not be commented or commented later (because some are difficult requiring much more time for thought/shower-thoughts/testing/user-comments to cook it or no extra input needed).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boost Multiplayer Activity: [/b]As some users explicitly wanted more players online, some multiplayer daily quests may be coded in later to boost multiplayer activity but careful consideration has to be made to prevent the impacts of cheating/botting. Also, a new experimental method #1 might be tested around Q4 2025 to gain users, and depending on the results, a different experimental method #2 later tested in gaining users in 2026. Though, it is more ideal and far easier to gain users after Early Access is over (because the Early Access badge does deter some users and the game will improve by then).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interesting visual improvements: [/b]Ideas included using emotion/key/chords, different visuals than vertical notebeams (clouds, rain, explosions, weather depending on mood etc) and more customization etc. It's impactful and not niche (impacting every user). I tried to code this a few months ago but was delayed due to both the difficulty and new critical feedback on #idea-forums from users that keep coming up.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you!
- TheAlanski@[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Sheet Music Reading Trainer & Training Statistics (Wrong Answers Appear More)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Sheet Music Trainer - train reading Sheet Music, select either the Treble or Bass clef.
[*] Training Statistics Added For Each Specific Answer: Wrong answers now appear more frequently!
[*] Notepad Improvements: Notepad paste and delete shortcuts (CTRL+V and CTRL+Backspace respectively), which replace the contents of the notepad quickly. New-line or CTRL delays removed for the QWERTY auto player. CTRL Y/Z for undo/redo added.
[*] Notebeam Label Setting: Can make it equal to the piano key label, the opposite, etc. By default it will now equal the same as the piano key label.
[*] Notebeam Style: Bone added.
[/list]
What's next?
[list]
[*] Improve visuals and general code quality, particularly multiplayer.
[*] I might plan to release it on other platforms if I can resolve Google Play issues with my Google Play Developer account: alanduu50@gmail.com.
[/list]
Thanks for your support!
- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Metronome, Random Velocity, Soft/Sostenuto Pedal, Better Notepad
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Metronome added.
[*] Name-able custom keyboard layouts + clone option (clone a custom keyboard layout) + delete layout option, custom layouts will get sorted alphabetically.
[*] QWERTY Auto-player improvements - set tempo, and can click to jump to a particular part of the sheet.
[*] Random Velocity - under (Settings > QWERTY Velocity), you can randomize the velocity between two values.
[*] Additional transpose shortcut - hold TAB and type out "-12" or "3" while TAB is held then it will set the transpose to that value.
[*] Sustain Cutoff (Release Time Multiplier) - adjustable in (Settings > Misc Audio).
[*] Midi playback - can now adjust the playback speed.
[*] Notebeam speed - adjust the notebeam speed (when it rises or falls during playback) under Settings > Theme.
[*] Soft & Sostenuto pedal (Settings > Controls)
[*] More options for live-recording
[*] A lot of bug fixes including video recording fixes.
[*] Setting to hide pedal/transpose/metronome.
[*] Notepad improvements: keyboard shortcut to go up/down with red line indicators to where the next section is with section numbers. Adjustable scrolling speed.
[/list]

Thank you for your support as always!
- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Shortcuts, Notepad Images, Steam Remote Play, Discord Contest, FPS & more!!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Custom keyboard shortcuts have been coded, e.g. set shortcuts for transpose, resetting transpose, navigation shortcuts etc. They can be accessed via [b]Settings > Controls[/b].
[*] Notepad - you can now paste images (shortcuts: CTRL+V, Del to delete, or use buttons near the top of the notepad).
[*] Steam Remote Play - this is an alternative to Multiplayer. Use whichever you prefer. It's different to Multiplayer, where it allows players to input their QWERTY into your computer (you are effectively streaming your game to the other players, so they don't need to own the game).
[*] Contest and rankings, these will be managed by noakopiano@ in the PianoGlow Discord server!
[*] Ear Training achievements
[*] Queueing re-order option - if there's multiple people in the queue (>2), there will be a up/down button for them to re-order the queue)
[*] FPS - adjustable in Settings > Windows/Monitors
[*] Discord bot - PianoGlow now has its own coded bot, for now it's just a /transpose and /contest command but it doesn't work perfectly yet (e.g. it doesn't re-order the notes for you)
[/list]

There is a small bug with QWERTY AutoPlayer and semi-auto, in addition to multiplayer connectivity issues that occur with some players. I will look into fixing these at the end of the month! Thank you for your patience!

Thanks for your support!
- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Mac release, gradient themes, chord identifiers & Happy Piano Day!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Happy Piano Day - 29th March 2025!
[*] Open the app on this special day to earn a surprise (*cough* achievement *cough*)! 🎹🎉 
[*] Gradient colors - you can now set the gradient color (and its direction).
[*] Chord identifiers & intervals - they are now shown when you play e.g. Am7, Major 3rd, etc.
[*] Piano Key Label - setting to choose whether to autoswitch or persist it to QWERTY controls vs musical notes.
[*] The Mac OSX version is now released. So now it supports both Windows and Mac OSX. But the Mac OSX version is super recent and has not undergone much user testing yet. Please email hi@alan.co.uk or join the Discord to report any issues!
[*] QWERTY & Midi note counter added to the bottom-left corner (autoswitches depending on what was last played)
[*] Multiplayer - online counter added and SoundFont used in queue mode is shown.
[/list]

Thank you!
- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Workshop, Ear Training, Treble & Bass Sheet Music Training & other updates!
notes.content:
Awesome updates!

[*] Workshop - publish QWERTY sheet music and download them from inside the app.
[*] Ear Training Mode - train relative pitch.
[*] Show treble & bass staff notation to train note-reading ability in sheet music.
[*] Falling notes mode - this was previously impossible/too-hard to use, adjusted so it now auto-pauses when needed so it's more possible, but it still requires some work/iteration.
[*] SoundFonts loading speed improved and a few more added. Multiplayer - the SoundFont you chose now has affect when other players hear you play.

Very happy by how much the community has grown! If you're having a good time, one of the best ways to support PianoGlow is by letting others know about your experience. Every bit of community support helps reach more players! Join the growing Discord community and suggest new ideas on the #ideas-forum channel.

- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Multiplayer improvements, Webcam, custom keybinds, UI improvements and more!
notes.content:
Epic updates to announce!

[list]
[*] Improved Multiplayer - queue mode (take turns playing), room name, room passwords, Steam profile link when you click on the player, ping next to player.
[*] Webcam - add a webcam right into the app so you can more quickly do screen recordings or content with your performances (use hashtag #PianoGlow when sharing on social media).
[*] Custom keybinds - adjust keybinds on the piano (you see the piano layout rather than the qwerty to customize it).
[*] Semi-auto mode - you can now semi-auto QWERTY pieces and just control the rhythm, this is available in the notepad.
[*] Improved file navigation - you can now sort by date asc/desc, and previous folders you've loaded/saved from will be displayed on the left hand side!
[*] Some random bug fixes (e.g. multiplayer lag, better chat input focus). Multiplayer is the least stable as it is a very new feature that has been undergoing rapid development recently.
[/list]

Thank you for the feedback (on Discord or Steam reviews)! I read every single one! The best way to suggest new ideas is through the Discord server in the #idea-forums channel or #bug-reports as the ideas are organized and other players can chip in their opinions/debate and vote using the heart reactions, though you are free to DM me on Discord otherwise.

The game is in Early Access and will do my best to continue updating!

Thank you for all your support!
- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Early Access Release, Custom Video Background, Auto-play, Achievements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Custom background now supports video & gif images, rather than just static images!
[*] Early Access released - and temporary discount applied! Buy now!
[*] Auto-play feature - in the notepad, you can now auto-play QWERTY sheet music you have to preview what the notes sounds like!
[*] Achievements!
[*] Settings, stats and save files are now stored on Steam Cloud so your PianoGlow will stay in sync on multiple devices!
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Multiplayer mode is out & cool updates!
notes.content:
Multiplayer along with a few features have been done!

As for the paid Early Access release, the ETA is around 10th March or so (at 10AM PST), then a couple of the demo's features (mainly transpose, theme, custom SF) will be disabled by then to make it different to the paid version.

Below are some updates:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer mode is out! Play & chat in a room of up to 8 players! For now, you can only see lobbies of players running the same version as you.
[*] Integration with the Wooting keyboard (using velocity estimation codes heavily inspired by Wooting) to measure the velocity of the Analog QWERTY keyboard to play notes loudly/softly using their keyboards. Thanks noakopiano@ for suggesting this awesome idea!
[*] Custom theme - upload image! With ambient noise option! Thanks noakopiano@ for these awesome ideas!
[*] New keybinds as requested by many players!
[*] Transposition works for out of range notes - thanks wisposhka@ for the idea!
[*] Experimental game modes - thanks APSSL@ for the idea. I also created a QWERTY typing (a bit like the online typing tests but for Virtual Piano).
[/list]

Really appreciate the community for the regular feedback! Don't forget to join the Discord community, it is growing! Hopefully the Discord community will grow much more after release! Look forward to hearing your piano covers.

Massive shoutout to noakopiano@ for providing regular feedback and ideas (and his awesome playing motivates me).

Thank you for your support!
- TheAlanski@

notes.title: Demo updates!
notes.content:
Updates since releasing the demo! These updates were heavily based on user ideas and feedback that was suggested through the Discord server!

[list]
[*] Added reverb settings with presets (Backrooms and Mom's Basement presets 💀) - thanks noakopiano for the idea!
[*] Transpose, invert pedal feature and extended CTRL keys - thanks noakopiano for the idea!
[*] Piano Note Beams in the down direction for Midi playback - this will help prepare me to add game modes (this idea from APSSL will take a long time to make).
[*] Heart Mode - just a few fun small mini-games to play with your partner, click on the Heart icon to try it out. This is not the main feature, was made just for fun.
[*] Notepad feature - resizable/draggable notepad for virtual sheets (thanks Yukqooo for the idea).
[*] Save playback as video (thank you for the idea Weslley Moura)
[*] Save Midi as Wav audio.
[*] Custom soundfonts (you can upload your own). Thanks brickhare for the idea
[*] Bug fixes such as Midi playback working better and the time slider working

[/list]

As for the release of the paid version, the ETA is mid to late March!
